title: Algorithms and Problem Solving
goal: Complexity, linear/binary search, bubble/selection/insertion/merge/quick sort aur two-pointer patterns.
definition: Algorithm problem solve karne ka finite steps ka sequence hai. Complexity batati hai input badhne par time/space kaise badhta hai (Big O).
explain: Big O worst-case growth batata hai: O(1) < O(log n) < O(n) < O(n log n) < O(n^2) < O(2^n). Constants ignore hote hain.
Linear search O(n), binary search O(log n) par sorted array chahiye. Bubble/selection/insertion O(n^2); merge sort O(n log n) stable; quick sort average O(n log n), worst O(n^2).
Two-pointer technique sorted array me pair/sum problems O(n) me solve karta hai; frequency counting hash/array se O(n) deti hai.
Algorithm likhne se pehle pseudocode aur dry run karo — edge cases (empty, one element, duplicates, negative) list karo.
analogy: Algorithm recipe hai aur complexity us recipe ka time estimate. Binary search cookbook me index ki tarah hai — sorted hone par aadha skip ho jaata hai.
why: Interview ka core algorithms aur complexity hai. Sahi algorithm chunna 10x performance deta hai, aur O(n^2) ko O(n log n) me badalna real difference hai.

syntax.note: mid overflow se bachne ke liye lo + (hi-lo)/2.
Best O(n) with swapped flag, average/worst O(n^2).

topics.title: Complexity
topics.body: Time/space Big O, best/average/worst. Nested loop often O(n^2), halving O(log n). Recursion me recurrence relation.

topics.title: Searching
topics.body: Linear O(n) unsorted. Binary O(log n) sorted; mid overflow-safe; duplicates ke liye first/last occurrence variants.

topics.title: Sorting
topics.body: Bubble/selection/insertion O(n^2) chhote data ke liye; merge O(n log n) stable extra space; quick average O(n log n) in-place worst O(n^2); counting sort O(n+k) range chhoti ho.

topics.title: Patterns
topics.body: Two pointers, sliding window, prefix sum, frequency map, binary search on answer. Problem decomposition: input → constraints → pattern → complexity.

debug.brief: Binary search infinite loop kar raha hai. Fix karo.
debug.code:
#include <stdio.h>
int main(void){int a[]={1,3,5};int lo=0,hi=2,key=5;while(lo<hi){int mid=(lo+hi)/2;if(a[mid]<key)lo=mid;else hi=mid;}printf("%d\n",a[lo]);return 0;}
hints: lo = mid se progress nahi hota.
debug.fix: if (a[mid] < key) lo = mid + 1; else hi = mid;

interview.a: Pivot hamesha smallest/largest ho (already sorted array with first/last pivot) to partitions unbalanced ho jaate hain — O(n^2). Random pivot ya median-of-three se avoid.
interview.followUp: Space? — average O(log n) recursion stack.

interview.q: Hash map se two-sum O(n) kaise?
interview.a: Ek pass me har element ke liye target - x dekho map me; mila to pair, warna x ko index ke saath store karo. Average O(n), O(n) space.
interview.followUp: Sorted array? — two pointers O(1) space.
